narr: Increasing moisture and clearing skies lead to the development of thunderstorms that produced heavy rain and flash flooding over Yavapai County.
ev: A stream gauge on Granite Creek (northeast of downtown Prescott--GRCA3) reported a 6.7 foot rise with a peak flow of 3,558 CFS. At least five roads were closed in Prescott due to flooding between 2:50 and 3:50 PM. Several roads were also closed in Wilhoit due to flooding. Two cars were stuck in flowing washes near Chino Valley/Paulden. Water was beginning to move the vehicles so Law Enforcement was called to the scene.
lsr: ROAD CLOSED AT LINCOLN AVE AND GROVE AVE DUE TO FLOODING. OTHER ROAD CLOSURES AROUND TOWN BETWEEN 2:50 AND 3:50 PM INCLUDED 1ST ST. SOUTH OF MERRITT, HILLSIDE AND 2ND ST., AND S. RUSH ST.
A STREAM GAUGE ON GRANITE CREEK NORTHEAST OF DOWNTOWN PRESCOTT (GRCA3) REPORTED A 6.7 FT RISE WITH A PEAK FLOW OF 3_558 CUBIC FT PER SECOND.
A STREAM GAUGE ON GRANITE CREEK NEAR DOWNTOWN PRESCOTT (GCRA3) REPORTED A 4.4 FOOT RISE WITH A PEAK FLOW OF 1_595 CUBIC FT PER SECOND.
ROAD CLOSED NEAR WILHOIT PUBLIC LIBRARY DUE TO FLOODING. ADDITIONAL ROAD CLOSURES FROM FLOODING ALONG WALDEN BLVD.
TWO CARS WERE STUCK IN WASHES NEAR CHINO VALLEY/PAULDEN DUE TO HIGH WATER. WATER WAS BEGINNING TO MOVE THE VEHICLES AND LAW ENFORCEMENT WAS CALLED TO THE SCENE.
